integrity: Theorem derived analytically and corroborated by a runnable standalone exact-rational checker. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact model-level comparison of two mutually exclusive sites, not simultaneous entry or profit maximization.
Positive fixed zonal demand and incumbent attraction; entrant attractiveness scales linearly in one parameter.
No competitor strategic reaction, demand expansion, or empirically calibrated geographic prediction.
Exact original-publication day of the 1963 Huff model unverified; 2010-12-30 is the earliest precisely date-verified source among those identified with a day.
Historical priority risk from accessible-abstract-only 2004 and 2010 studies; independent validation not performed.
title: A sharp two-zone double reversal in probabilistic retail site selection
